mainEntity.name: What is Daily Deal Website Script?

acceptedAnswer.text: Daily Deal Website Script (HouponDeal) is an open source Groupon/Cobone Clone PHP script developed by RedSpider Systems. It allows you to start your own group buying website with features like free themes, payment gateway integration, and mobile version.
It supports multiple payment gateways including PayPal, 2Checkout, Authorize.net, and Credit Card. It also supports social media integration with Facebook and Twitter.
